project.name: talos-fleet-controller
project.summary: Kubernetes controller for declarative Talos Linux node config convergence and OS upgrades through a FleetNodeSet CRD.
goals: Provide a Kubernetes-native controller for Talos machine config convergence and OS upgrades.
Keep the FleetNodeSet API, controller behavior, generated manifests, Helm chart, examples, and image build path coherent.
Preserve day-2 safety controls including drift detection, maintenance windows, dry-run, pause, health checks, and limited unavailability.
nonGoals: Own Talos Linux, Omni, Cluster API provisioning, or bare-metal lifecycle outside the documented FleetNodeSet surface.
Encode one cluster's site-specific topology, credentials, IP plan, or rollout policy as controller defaults.
Publish enterprise doctrine, project manifest schema, org rulesets, rollout issue reconciliation, or shared CI policy.

owns.name: fleetnodeset-api
owns.description: The fleet.talos.dev FleetNodeSet Kubernetes API, generated CRD, samples, and compatibility expectations.

owns.name: talos-reconcile-controller
owns.description: Controller-runtime reconciliation that compares desired Talos version and machine config with node state and applies safe updates.

owns.name: controller-distribution
owns.description: Dockerfile, GHCR image build workflow, Helm chart, config manifests, and raw deploy examples for running the controller.

doesNotOwn: Talos Linux core behavior, Omni, Cluster API provisioning, Kubernetes cluster ownership, or consumer GitOps topology.
Site-specific machine config, node labels, secrets, IP addressing, maintenance policy, or workload scheduling policy.
Enterprise doctrine, project manifest schema, rollout issue reconciliation, org rulesets, or shared workflow implementation.

allowedDependencies.surface: project manifest schema, standards, and rollout audit
documented Talos API and client behavior
Kubebuilder scaffolding and generated Kubernetes API conventions

forbiddenCouplings: Do not require consumers to import internal Go packages instead of using the documented CRD, chart, image, or manifests.
Do not bake one cluster's credentials, node inventory, topology, IP addressing, or maintenance schedule into controller defaults.
Do not edit generated Kubebuilder artifacts directly; update source markers and regenerate.
Do not publish enterprise process policy from this repository instead of SylphxAI/doctrine or SylphxAI/.github.

delivery.deployPath: Pull requests and merge groups run build, lint, unit, and e2e workflows; main pushes and tags build and push the controller image to GHCR.
delivery.productionProof: Controller changes require CI plus image readback or cluster smoke evidence for the affected FleetNodeSet reconcile path before claiming production readiness.

gaps.description: Upgrade from legacy workflow contexts to ADR-29 admission contexts when the controller is ready for full central policy enforcement.
Document CRD versioning, backward compatibility, and forward-only recovery expectations for already-applied cluster APIs.
Document the cluster smoke, image readback, and reconcile evidence required after image-producing changes.
